_about: Massing of the landmarks, one entry per OSM way. Frame: u metres from the facade inward along the footprint's long axis, v metres across from the facade's left as seen by someone standing in front of it. Heights in metres above the ground. Sources: OSM ways and building:part ways, es.wikipedia (Catedral Nueva 105 x 43.5 m, main dome 12 m wide and 53 m high; San Sebastian tower on the left of the facade, dome over the apse), and Wikimedia Commons photos (CC BY-SA) for towers, domes and heights scaled against facade widths. Second round (San Alfonso, San Blas, El Carmen, Todos Santos, Las Conceptas, La Merced, El Cenáculo, Buen Pastor, Corte Provincial de Justicia): towers, spires and domes from one Commons photo each, heights scaled against the facade's width; the Corte's dome stands on its corner over Parque Calderón.

landmarks.name: Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepción (Catedral Nueva)
landmarks._note: Towers 14.8 x 15.6 m from the footprint's corners; heights from Commons photos (seen from the southeast and from Parque Calderón): cornice ~30.5 m, towers ~43 m, scaled so the main dome tops out near Wikipedia's 53 m. Openings: per tower a portal, two paired arched windows (the upper in a blind arch), the belfry arch and a row of small round holes; the central portal, the blind arch and the rose window; seven bays on each side, each a blind arch with a round window and a paired window under it.
